subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Which Google Chat user-auth model should the bundled plugin support for outbound reactions, native attachment uploads, and email-address direct-message lookup?
rationale: Current main deliberately exposes service-account authentication only, while refresh-token OAuth and delegated service-account impersonation create different secret, consent, administrative, and privilege boundaries that automation cannot select safely.

options.title: Scoped user OAuth
options.body: Add client credentials and refresh-token SecretRefs, using the user client only for operations whose Google contract requires user authentication.

options.title: Domain-wide delegation
options.body: Support service-account impersonation of a configured Workspace user, accepting the broader administrator setup and privilege boundary.

options.title: Keep app auth only
options.body: Retain service-account-only operation and rely on explicit unsupported errors or safe text-link fallbacks instead of native user-auth features.

recommendation.title: Scoped user OAuth
recommendation.body: Add client credentials and refresh-token SecretRefs, using the user client only for operations whose Google contract requires user authentication.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history includes the most directly relevant Google Chat authentication transport and API security-hardening work.
